# Photo Editor

Photo editor: edit a photo or image from your MegaScenes library by describing the change. Swap the background, remove or add objects, change colors or style, retouch, or combine images.

## What it does
Pick a photo from your MegaScenes library (upload it in the Studio, or make one with the Image plugin) and say what to change. Claude tells you the price and makes the edited image; ask for another change in the same chat.

**How the files are made:** each image edit is generated by an image model. Nothing is made until you say yes, and the price in credits comes first.

Starts from an image in your MegaScenes library: files attached in the chat are not passed to the plugin.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install photo-editor@megascenes
```

## Connecting
- Photo Editor talks to the MegaScenes server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/image-editor/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting opens MegaScenes: sign in, create an account, or continue without one and add your email when you pay (OAuth with PKCE). Then you come straight back to the chat.
- Each image edit uses credits from your MegaScenes account and is priced before it runs; new accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- The image edits show in a viewer in the chat where Claude supports interactive apps; in Claude Code you get the links.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_image_edit_models` | Models for image edits with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_image_edit_cost` | Exact price of one image edit before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_image_edit` | Starts one image edit in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_image_edit` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `list_my_images` | Your uploads and images made here, to pick the one to start from. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "Replace the background of my latest MegaScenes photo with a beach"
- "Remove the person on the left from my last photo"
- "Turn my latest image into a watercolor painting"

## Data and privacy
What you give for the image edit (the photo you pick from your library and the change you describe) goes to MegaScenes, stays in your MegaScenes account with the finished file, and is passed to the model provider that makes it. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
